title: Getting Started
description: The shortest path from a fresh clone to your first shipped documentation page.

cards.title: Set Up Your Environment
cards.description: Install dependencies and start the dev server. The app reloads automatically as you edit source files.

cards.title: Add Your First Doc Page
cards.description: Every section (Projects, Modules, Components, API, Libraries) is a JSON file of nested cards. Add a node with a unique id, title and description to the relevant *-content.json file to create a new page — no component code required.

notes.text: Nodes can nest arbitrarily deep via children. Each one gets its own real URL, e.g. /modules/authentication/route-guards.

related.label: How to Add a New Documentation Section

cards.title: Validate and Test Your Change
cards.description: Run the test suite before opening a pull request. The schema validation spec catches structural mistakes — a missing id, an unknown field — before you even open the browser.

notes.text: additionalProperties is false in every content schema. A typo'd field name (e.g. descriptoin) fails validation instead of silently being ignored.
